# SpatialChat

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 15 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Virtual-events marketing: purple news bar, white header, 12px-radius purple and outlined buttons, gradient hero, pricing tabs and plan cards, and a signed-out login with Google, Apple, and an email field.

Captured 2026-11-19, signed out (marketing home and /pricing measured; login at app.spatial.chat/login measured and not submitted; Buy Now, Stripe trial, Book a Demo, Google, and Apple not followed). Themes: light.

SpatialChat is a virtual events and meetings product. This package covers the public marketing site at https://spatial.chat/ and the signed-out login at https://app.spatial.chat/login, measured on 2026-11-19. No account was created. Themes seen: light only. Widths measured: 1440 and 390 CSS px.

## Typography

11 styles from `core.typography`. `fontFamily` is the first family of each stack; the full stacks, and properties DESIGN.md has no field for (text case, decoration), are in tokens.json. Families: Euclid Circular B, Satoshi.

### Fonts (from README.md)

Marketing uses Satoshi (computed on body; weights 400, 500, and 700 loaded). The login form uses Euclid Circular B (weights 400, 500, and 600 in `@font-face`). OAuth labels use an Apple system stack. Inter 500 was loaded on the login page and used by the reCAPTCHA links. These families are proprietary or licensed to the product. The tokens name them. The style guide falls back to the system face. Caveat and IBM Plex Mono are requested by a Google Fonts link on the marketing page and were not the computed face of the captured text.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

The hero section's computed background-color is white, while its stylesheet also sets a multi-stop gradient. Both are recorded. Heading sizes in the stylesheet (h1 50px, h2 38px) are smaller than the computed sizes at 1440 (60px and 48px). Tokens use the computed sizes. The email field was focused before its border was read, so the resting border is not isolated. Login `--dash-*` variables exist in stylesheets and were not the computed style of the login page. The Chatwoot bubble colour is a third-party widget.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

**Purple is the marketing action colour, and the login Continue button is a different purple.** Start for Free, Book a Demo, and Buy Now use #5727e7. Continue on the login form uses #5b5bf5. Do not paint the login button with the marketing accent.

**Outlined buttons are the quiet pair.** Login and Try it Free are transparent or white with a 1px black border and 12px radius. The filled button is the one purple action in that group.

**The news bar is a full-width purple strip, not a badge.** It is 54px, #5727e7, with white 16px text. The New tag is a separate 8px-radius chip.

**Plan prices use the accent, and plan names stay black.** $399 is #5727e7 at 32px. Free and Business are black at 40px on desktop.

**Do not follow Buy Now or submit the email form when matching this package.** Those paths were measured and not entered. Checkout and the signed-in app are outside this capture.
